findings.evidence: Lines 397–403 set `toLinearMap := (dotProductEquiv ℤ (Fin 6)).toLinearMap`, while the only related public lemma at lines 414–415 is `e6SimplyConnectedRootDatum_pairing`, restricted to `i j : Fin 72`; `G2.lean:138` provides the missing parallel arbitrary-vector lemma.
findings.fix: Add an `@[simp]` lemma stating `e6SimplyConnectedRootDatum.toLinearMap x y = x ⬝ᵥ y`, analogous to `g2SimplyConnectedRootDatum_toLinearMap`.
findings.issue: The public datum defines `toLinearMap` using `dotProductEquiv`, but its API only characterizes `pairing i j` for tabulated roots; consumers cannot rewrite `toLinearMap x y` for arbitrary character and cocharacter vectors without unfolding the datum.

summary: The datum lacks a public characterization of its perfect pairing on arbitrary lattice elements, forcing consumers to unfold the definition outside root-index pairings.
